decisions.decision: Export FrameWebforCS PICKUP displacement and support reactions as separate 17-column UTF-8 CSV files in both 2D and 3D, using committed Derived.Pickups with selected max/min COMBINE IDs and all six correlated components.
decisions.rationale: Node results have no established .pik schema. Explicit per-component raw result units, rad rotations, force*length moments, invariant round-trip numbers, and topology node order preserve provenance and precision. Validate node/support eligibility, source IDs, complete finite vectors and matching extrema before atomically saving.
decisions.alternatives: Reuse the member/station-specific fixed-width section-force .pik schema; export rounded display strings or omit out-of-plane correlated components in 2D.
